newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 17.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- The Ministry of Agriculture intensifies efforts to raise the quality of early season rice with better scientific farming techniques.
- A commentary says some Western countries use the pretext of human rights to launch attacks on developing countries and developing countries will not yield to such power politics.
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Sichuan province's Chongqing city is moving to readjust its industrial mix, focusing on the automobile, chemical and metallurgy sectors.
CHINA DAILY
- 60 percent of China's major industries have applied international standards to their products and more will be adopted this year by the State Bureau of Technical Supervision
- About 1,300 candidates took an open examination to fill 57 intermediate-level official posts in Beijing on Saturday.
- A five-km highway bridge linking Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, with neighboring Hong Kong will be built to boost the economic development of the whole of south China.
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Central bank governor Dai Xianglong urges financial institutions to cut unhealthy loans and curb risk
- Total assets of China Investment Bank reach 63 billion yuan
- Yizheng Chemical Fibre obtains $400 million loans from the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
- China Everbright Securities wins approval to conduct foreign exchange business
CHINA BUSINESS DAILY
- China fixed asset investment in state sector seen at 152.15 billion yuan in first quarter, up 17.2 percent
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- China says exporting a range of fighter aircraft to unidentified foreign markets
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- China Petroleum Corp Pipeline Bureau makes 206 million yuan profits in 1996
